descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Welcome to Frank's Paint Co. You are the new painter in town, and the job board is full.

FIVE JOBS, FIVE CLIENTS
- Lily's Bedroom: Jenna and her daughter want every wall sky blue.
- The Corner Cafe: Rosa wants two-tone walls with a perfect line. Tape it first!
- The Family Room: Marcus wants a navy accent wall and warm greige everywhere else.
- The Gallery Loft: Nina wants three bold stripes high above the city.
- Ashford Manor: Mr. Ashford's great hall, burgundy below the chair rail and soft gold above.

REAL CLIENTS
Every client greets you, explains the job in their own voice, watches you work and reacts to the result. When you are done, call them over: they check every wall with their clipboard and rate you out of three stars. Great work earns a big tip.

REAL TOOLS
Rollers, brushes, blue masking tape that peels off for a crisp edge, an inspection lamp that makes missed spots glow, and HVLP and airless paint sprayers. Buy new gear from Sam at the supply counter with the money you earn.

FREE PAINT
A big studio plus every job room: every colour on the wheel, every tool, no clients. Just paint.

Groove to a funky soundtrack while you work, or switch the music off in the menu.
